key_insight: Meta² learns reusable guidance offline so an online evolver can adapt a frozen-model agent’s harness to each task without test-time verifier feedback.
engineering_relevance: Long-horizon agents can adjust prompts, tools, memory, and hooks during execution while preserving environment state and task progress.
method: Contrast training rollouts with no evolver, a Meta-Skill-guided evolver, and an evolver given training-only privileged verifier information.
Aggregate trajectory and outcome differences into a textual Meta-Skill describing when to intervene, when to keep the harness unchanged, and which edits to avoid.
Freeze the Meta-Skill online; use emerging evidence to choose KEEP or EVOLVE, with edits confined to the current run.
evidence_signal: With GPT-5.6-Terra, Meta² achieved the highest performance among evaluated methods on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (81.00%) and DeepSWE 1.1 (44.44%); ablations supported contrastive guidance and task-local edits.
watch_item: Results cover two benchmarks with one reported model, leaving broader transfer and online intervention overhead uncertain.
paper_title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
